Salesforce Developers URL Source: http://developer.salesforce.com/builtwitheinstein Markdown Content: # Showcase your agent-first business solution #BuiltWithAgentforce. ## Share a video of your own innovative Agentforce use case. Envision Agentforce solutions that would benefit a business from your industry or other sectors. Build your own agent and extend it by creating one or more custom actions using Flow, Apex, or a prompt template. Alternatively, build an agent that leverages Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to harness the power of unstructured data, such as in PDFs. Learn more ![Image 1: Social media post from Allen Chen about what he built with Einstein Copilot](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/einstein-copilot-post.png) ![Image 2](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/copilot-bush.png)![Image 3](https://developer.salesforce.com/ns-assets/copilot-rocks.png) ## Explore use cases from Salesforce experts. Now is your opportunity to showcase your own innovative Agentforce use case for a chance to win* a TrailblazerDX pass or Agentblazer hoodie.
